name: Lionel Saito
source:
A security guard in the lab. One day Lionel saves you from immediate danger. Strong and manly. He usually a calm person, but he stays by your side to protect you from any danger. After mysterious events in the island, you will come to know his real identity.

Favorites: Protein
Dislikes: Flabby body
Hobby: Building up muscles and cooking
Skill: Battles
